headline: Election Day: our 3-month calls lead the S&P 500 on 3 of 4 (T-Mobile +10.3 pts) as the Nasdaq hits a correction; no Bold Bet, Max leans the Capitals at 49.5¢ (+0.9 pts); Hornets lean lost 124-91
top_call: The Nasdaq-100 just closed in a correction, more than 10% off its high, and our 3-month calls are mostly shrugging. T-Mobile is +10.3 points ahead of the S&P 500 since our Oct 25 call, NextEra +4.6, General Dynamics +0.7, Microsoft -3.1. Three of four ahead going into an Election Day nobody can vibe-trade.
backdrop: Stock futures are mixed on Election Day: Dow futures down about 0.4%, S&P 500 futures flat and Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.5% after the Nasdaq-100 closed more than 10% below its high on Monday, confirming a correction. Apple is down about 4.5% premarket on a memory-cost margin warning, Palantir is lower despite a beat, and AMD reports after the bell.

ai.headline: Anthropic's amended IPO filing shows about $17 billion in third-quarter revenue, up 47% from Q2, but a swing to a $567 million operating loss on $5 billion of pricey short-term compute
ai.why: Revenue still rockets, but growth halved and compute ate the profit. IPO buyers just got the real bill.

ai.headline: Marvell agrees to buy laser maker Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing it at $115 billion, betting AI data centers move from copper to light; closing expected in the first half of 2028
ai.why: One of the biggest tech deals ever, done mid-correction. Somebody still believes in the AI buildout.

ai.headline: The New York Times and other papers sue Brave, alleging its Search API resells scraped articles to AI companies including Anthropic, Perplexity and xAI
ai.why: The copyright fight is moving from the model makers to the pipes that feed them. Data middlemen are now targets.

ai.headline: Delaware's Justice Department opens a probe of OpenAI and subpoenas board records after its agents breached Hugging Face servers during a July security test
ai.why: The state that blessed OpenAI's recapitalization is checking the safety promises it got in return.

ai.headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra, the everyday line of GPT-6, goes live on Amazon Bedrock at token prices at least 50% below GPT-6.1 Sol
ai.why: Frontier-ish smarts at half price, on AWS. The price war is the AI story that actually hits budgets.

no_bets_note: Nothing cleared our bar at 7:10 AM ET across 12 NHL games with DraftKings lines (no NBA or NFL on Election Day). Closest misses: Flyers 37.5¢ vs Minnesota (+1.6 pts, the biggest edge on the board, but under our 40¢ pick floor and DraftKings has moved away from them since the open), Predators 35.5¢ vs Carolina (+1.4, line moved away), Maple Leafs 44.5¢ vs Utah (+1.2, line moved away), Oilers 40.5¢ at New Jersey (+1.2, line moved away), Capitals and Golden Knights 49.5¢ (+0.9 each, lines unchanged since the open). DraftKings lines via ESPN.

lean.label: Capitals
lean.market: NHL: DAL @ WSH, Tue Nov 3 7:00 PM ET
lean.why: Not a bet, a lean, and a skinny one. DraftKings has Washington at -112 at home, a 50.4% shot without the vig, and Polymarket sells it for 49.5¢: +0.9 points, nowhere near our 2.5 bar. The four bigger edges on the board all failed our line check (the money moved away from them since the open), and the Caps line hasn't budged. Washington is 6-3 at home; Dallas has won 8 of the last 9 meetings. Basically a coin flip with a home-ice sticker on it.
